[*][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=4]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=4]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/b]
[/list][b]
[/b]
[b]Huge thanks for helping with better code [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Smashley41]Smashley41[/url] [/u]! [/b]


[center][size=3]This [b][color=#e06666]mod is not compatible with other NPC sprite mod[/color][/b], if u want to use it with other sprite mods you will have to manually edit json files.[/size][/center]
[center][size=3]This [b][color=#e06666]mod works with SVE[/color][/b], however [color=#e06666][b]some sprites may remain old[/b] (example: Wizard, Marlon, Morris).[/color]
[b][color=#f1c232] I will do SVE compatible version in the future. [/color][/b][/size][/center][b]
